subject: MAP: Rapid onboarding playbook — API keys, allowlist & VPC peering
messages:
From: Alex Santos <alex@beacondx.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwoodinference.com>, Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@beacondx.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Nov 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: MAP kickoff — BeaconDX POC items (API keys, allowlist, peering)

Hi Neha / team,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — BeaconDX is excited to get a fast POC running. We want to land the Mutual Action Plan and lock the close timeline this week. To make progress we need a concrete checklist from Redwood for the environment handoff:

- API key provisioning and RBAC for the POC org
- IP allowlist / CIDR ranges for early traffic (we can provide our staging IPs)
- VPC peering steps (our infra team prefers a scheduled maintenance window)
- Any short-lived service accounts or certs we should create

Can you confirm what you need from our side (exact formats, owner contacts) and whether we can hit a pilot by Nov 30? Marta (ops) will own final signoff for peering.

Appreciate a compact runbook or spreadsheet we can use for internal tracking.

Best,
Alex
Senior Platform Engineer, BeaconDX

---

From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Santos <alex@beacondx.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Nov 2028 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — BeaconDX POC items (API keys, allowlist, peering)

Hi Alex / Marta,

Great to hear you're ready to move quickly. Below is a concise MAP-oriented checklist and the specific artifacts we need from BeaconDX to reach a Nov 30 pilot: 

1) API keys & org setup
   - Deliverable from Redwood: POC org created in our console; one admin API key + one scoped key for staging.
   - Action for BeaconDX: Confirm admin contact (name + email) and preferred key rotation cadence.
   - Artifact: sample JSON for key creation (we will attach).

2) IP allowlist
   - We need a list of public egress IPs (CIDR preferred). For initial testing, a /24 is fine; production later will use narrower ranges.
   - BeaconDX deliverable: CSV with name, IP/CIDR, owner/contact, earliest activation date.

3) VPC peering & network schedule
   - Redwood provides peering config + BGP hints in a short doc. Peering requires a 60-minute maintenance window.
   - For Nov 30 target, we should schedule peering the week prior (Nov 27–29) to allow smoke tests.

4) Service accounts and certs
   - If you prefer short-lived service accounts, list intended kube namespaces and principal. Otherwise we will use workload tokens.

I've attached a compact MAP workbook (redwood-map-v1.xlsx) that maps these items to owners, ETA, and acceptance criteria. Please fill columns A–E for each row so we can move to canary traffic quickly.

Jonas (networking) and Jordan (sales ops) are looped for runbook details and scheduling. Monica will coordinate the mutual close milestone.

Next steps: BeaconDX to fill the workbook and send a short list of allowed CIDRs. After we confirm, Jonas will propose two peering slots.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-map-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 220KB)

---

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwoodinference.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwoodinference.com>, Alex Santos <alex@beacondx.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>, Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@beacondx.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Nov 2028 16:20:00 +0100
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — BeaconDX POC items (API keys, allowlist, peering)

Alex / Marta / Neha — quick network note from my side: 

1) Peering prep checklist (summary):
   - Exchange VPC IDs and region (we support us-west-2 and eu-west-1 for this POC).
   - Confirm ASN (we will use our standard ASN unless you request otherwise).
   - Agree on BGP communities and route filters (I put defaults in the attached PDF).
   - Schedule 60-minute window; allow 30 min follow-up for validation.

2) For the Nov 27–29 window I have two open slots (Nov 28 09:00–10:00 PT and Nov 29 14:00–15:00 PT). Please indicate preference in the workbook.

3) Security & access: If BeaconDX wants IP-based allowlist + short-lived service tokens, we can configure prefix caching for the demo to keep latency predictable.

I attached a short peering instruction PDF (vpc-peering-instructions.pdf) and added a couple of inline notes in the MAP workbook.

Cheers,
Jonas Weber
Principal Network Engineer | Redwood Inference

Attachments: vpc-peering-instructions.pdf (PDF, 48KB)

---

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Santos <alex@beacondx.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwoodinference.com>, Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@beacondx.com>
Date: Fri, 17 Nov 2028 15:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — BeaconDX POC items (API keys, allowlist, peering)

Thanks everyone — quick confirmation from the deal/ops side:

- Alex / Marta: please complete the redwood-map-v1.xlsx by COB Monday (Nov 20). Key fields: admin contact, CSV of CIDRs, target peering slot.
- Once we have the completed sheet, Redwood will: provision the POC org, generate initial keys (admin + scoped), and schedule the peering.
- I will raise a mutual close milestone in HubSpot and set the acceptance criteria (pilot traffic + basic SLA checks) for Nov 30. HubSpot deal link: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/BDX-423

If BeaconDX wants us to run a pre-peering smoke test with synthetic traffic, we can do that on Nov 26. Please indicate in the sheet.

Looking forward to wrapping this up quickly.

Best,
Monica Patel
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

P.S. If helpful I can also route a short DocuSign for the POC addendum (we usually use a simple SOW + data processing appendix).
